name: Stick Figure Lesson
summary: A stick figure walks in, points at a hand-drawn bar chart as it draws on, and says a three-word line.
bestFor: Friendly explainers for training and school topics
prompt: Teach why regular practice matters using a simple stick figure. The figure walks in, then points at a hand-drawn chart while four bars are drawn one after another, each taller than the last. A trend arrow is drawn across the bars. The figure ends with a short speech bubble that sums up the lesson. Keep the narration warm, plain and encouraging.
